overview_description.description: Lokalee is a hospitality technology company that provides an AI-driven digital guest experience platform for hotels, resorts, and travel operators. The platform is designed to centralize guest services, local recommendations, and trip-planning tools into a single branded interface that enhances the end-to-end travel experience.
